subject: [hw] V16 -> D01: six facts for FACTS.md (T32 branch bit layout, LDRD/STRD pairs, TBB PC base, PLDW, cp15 MRC words)
body:
For FACTS.md, section 4 (instruction census) or a new "T32 encodings" table.  All [V] unless marked.

1. [V] T32 B.W / B<c>.W / BL / BLX bit layout (checked against llvm-mc --show-encoding, ld.lld and the vendor code over the whole immediate range; evidence: emu/test_v16/gen_enc.py tables + test, and libvcodecdrv.so branches):
   - hw2 bits 10-0 = offset bits 11:1 (imm11); hw1 bits 9-0 = offset bits 21:12 (imm10).
   - 25-bit forms (B.W T4, BL T1): I2 = bit22 = NOT(hw1[10] XOR hw2[11]), I1 = bit23 = NOT(hw1[10] XOR hw2[13]), S = bit24 = hw1[10].
   - B<c>.W (T3, 21-bit): bit18 = hw2[13], bit19 = hw2[11], sign bit20 = hw1[10]; hw2[12] = 0.
   - The discriminator between B.W and B<c>.W is hw2 bit 12 (1 = B.W/BL space, 0 = B<c>.W), NOT hw1 bits 9-6: b.w #0 = f000 b800, bne.w #0 = f040 8000, bl = f000 f800, blx = f000 e800.  In B.W, hw1[9:6] are imm10 bits 9-6.
   - BLX has hw2 bit 0 = H (offset bit 1), hw2 bits 10-1 = imm10 (offset bits 11:2), and its target is Align(PC,4)+imm; BL/B.W use PC+imm.
2. [V] LDRD/STRD with arbitrary register pairs are used by the phone libraries: 4309 of the 5223 ldrd/strd words in the linear llvm-objdump of libvcodecdrv/libvpud_vcodec/libvcodec_utility have an odd Rt or an encoded Rt2 != Rt+1 (e.g. strd r3, r1, [sp, #8] at libvpud_vcodec.so 0x88f2 = e9cd 3102; ldrd r2, r0, [sp] at 0x86d4 = e9dd 2000).  llvm-mc assembles them.  ARMv7 calls them UNPREDICTABLE; ARMv8-A hardware executes them (Rt at addr, Rt2 at addr+4), so the interpreter does too.
3. [V] TBB/TBH with Rn = 1111 use PC exactly (c->r[15] = address + 4), no Align(PC,4); a 32-bit T32 instruction can be 2 mod 4 (T01 k_switch_dense; review finding F13; vendor code tbh [pc, r0, lsl #1] at libvcodecdrv.so 0x7621e).
4. [V] PLDW is encoded as Rt = 1111 in the LDRH imm12 slot, not a separate space: pldw [r0, #4084] = f8b0 fff4 at libvcodecdrv.so 0xf9c10; pld [r1, #x] = f89x fxxx (LDRB slot), pli = f99x (LDRSB slot), pld [pc, #-imm] = f81f (LDRB imm8 slot with Rn = 15).
5. [V] The three largest libraries contain no MRC p15, c13, c0, 3.  The only cp15 words are 9 mrc + 4 mcr + 1 mrrc of the form p15, opc1 1..6, apsr_nzcv/pc, cN, cM, #7 with hw2 = 0xFFxx (e.g. eed2 fff9), i.e. exactly the kind of word that data produces; they are UNDEF in V16 by task contract.
6. [V] No LDM/STM in the three libraries has SP in its register list and none has an empty list (checked all push.w/pop.w/ldm/stm/ldmdb/stmdb forms; list contents range from {r1} to {r4-r11, lr}/{r4-r11, pc}), which is why V16 returns UNDEF for an empty list and for SP in the list.

Environment note: the byte order in llvm-mc --show-encoding output is memory order, so [0xd1,0xe8,0x4f,0x0f] is hw1 = 0xe8d1, hw2 = 0x0f4f (I initially read the second halfword reversed; worth a FACTS line since it burned an hour).  The T32 exclusive B/H/D layout is hw2 = Rt(15-12) | Rt2-or-1111(11-8) | 04/05/07(7-4) | Rd-or-1111(3-0).
